# Manifest Kit

*Generate operating systems from a single manifest.*

* **Status:** alpha ([what this means](status-vocabulary.md#alpha))
* **Language:** Rust
* **Kind:** infrastructure
* **Has real code today:** Yes
* **Source:** not public yet

## What it owns

Build-time infrastructure kit: **each OS or app is one manifest over a common component catalog**. Also owns the shared cross-platform target axis schema that any kit with more than one build target selects against, instead of inventing its own per-kit target list.

## What it will not do

* Board bring-up or device drivers (Platform Kit / Device Kit concern)
